name: popover
useFor: Use for a little interactive content tied to a control: a short form (Add seats), an explanation behind an info glyph, a picker. Put PopoverTitle and PopoverDescription in PopoverHeader. For plain text on hover use Tooltip; for a list of actions use Dropdown Menu; for a task that needs full attention use Dialog.
constraints: Content that only appears on hover
source: The Hoplite website's popups (.hn__sheet: the ground panel and quiet line) and nav rows (.hn__item-label, .hn__item-body: 14px medium over 14px quiet).
title: Popover
description: A square 288px panel of the ground with 16px of air, a quiet hairline and a long soft cast, 8px from its trigger: a 14px medium title over a quiet 14px line, as the nav's rows read, then any small form or detail. It opens from its trigger with a fade and a slight scale.
